name: jitter-estimator-calibration
description: Calibration anchor for DR-0012: the already-calibrated trnoise() source pushed through a comparator bit-extraction step and a most-common-value min-entropy point estimator, at three bias levels chosen so the closed-form P(bit=1)=Phi(bias/NA) gives H in {1.0, 0.5, 0.1} bit/sample. See sim/tools/jitter_estimator_calibration_check.py for the derivation and the --check comparison.
noise_params: trnoise(NA=2.2361e-3 NT=1e-11 NALPHA=0 NAMP=0); same S/H mapping validated in sim/tb/trnoise-calibration (S_w = 2*NA^2*NT). Each held sample v(nw) ~ N(0, NA^2); thresholding v(nw)+bias against 0 gives P(bit=1) = Phi(bias/NA) exactly.
